methodology.observations: Each agency keeps its own observation period, collection time, cadence and failure state.
methodology.retention: A temporary source failure retains previously verified records as stale; it never silently replaces populated history with an empty result.
methodology.keys: EIA, BEA and Census use free API keys stored only in GitHub Actions Secrets. BLS can run without a key; SEC and USGS require no key.
methodology.consensus: No market consensus estimates are created by these official feeds.
methodology.censusCodes: Census records preserve official data-type and category codes until a verified dictionary join is available.
methodology.usgs: USGS integration tracks the official annual release and does not OCR or estimate values from PDF tables.
methodology.asxAnnouncements: Public per-company ASX announcement metadata and official document links are collected for a configured watchlist. This is not the licensed complete real-time ComNews service.
methodology.federalReserveReleases: Official Federal Reserve RSS headline and link metadata is collected for monetary policy, speeches, testimony, and credit/liquidity or balance-sheet releases.
methodology.rbaMediaReleases: Official Reserve Bank of Australia media-release headline and link metadata is collected from the public RBA RSS feed for AUD and ASX-relevant policy coverage.
methodology.usdaWasde: Official USDA World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) release metadata and document links are collected from the public USDA ESMIS API as a scheduled agricultural mover.
methodology.newsInterpretation: Official announcement and policy-release records are evidence inputs only; the collector does not infer market direction or investment conclusions.
